decisionsTitle: The calendar under «Aspectul nou» draws closer to the mock-up
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-12, beside a screenshot of the mock-up and of QA:** "have arrows on the month; have that «Alergăm împreună în Brașov» nice text on the right; have nicer buttons; have more details on the calendar card; have better icons on the apps links (Google, Apple, Outlook); overall match the aesthetics of the proposed one."

**Decision.** Under «Aspectul nou» only — off, the calendar is drawn as before:

- **‹ Month ›.** From `sm` the previous and next arrows stand either side of the month's name, which is set in the display face; the period row's pair is not drawn there. A phone, where the heading is not drawn (§487), keeps the row's pair beside «Azi». Both pairs are the same `CalendarStepLink`, so the swipe and the arrows still go to one address.
- **The motto.** «Alergăm împreună în Brașov.» / "We run together in Brașov." in the handwriting face (Caveat, already in the repository, §460, never preloaded), tilted, a stroke of the accent under it, at the title block's right from `lg` — where the line beside it leaves room. Real text, read by a screen reader.
- **Buttons.** The kind and surface chips are buttons: a card with a soft shadow each, 10-pixel corners, the chosen one filled. «Lună / An» and «Calendar / Listă» are two segmented controls, «Azi» a small outlined button. Every target stays 44 pixels on a phone.
- **The entry in the grid.** From `sm` an entry is the dot, the glyphs and the time on its first line, then the whole title on up to two lines (it was cut after a letter or two); the cells are taller to hold it. A phone's 40-pixel column is unchanged.
- **The apps' logos.** Google's «G» in its four colours, Apple's apple in the text's ink, Outlook's mark in its blues, and a chevron at each row's end. The logos' colours are tokens of their own in `brand.ts` (`PROVIDER_LOGO`), not the club's palette.

**Refused.** The mock-up drops the month and year selects; they stay, since they are the only way to jump a year on a phone. The next-event panel's pills were left as they are: they already carry what the mock-up shows that the event has.
changelogLine: - **The calendar closer to the mock-up, under «Aspectul nou»** — arrows either side of the month's name, «Alergăm împreună în Brașov.» handwritten at the right of the title, button-like filter chips and segmented «Lună / An» and «Calendar / Listă», each entry in the grid showing its time and then its whole title, and the Google, Apple and Outlook rows with each app's own logo. Off, nothing changes. §NNN.
batchLine: the calendar closer to the mock-up under «Aspectul nou»
